primaryChecks.text: After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
